responsibility: Implements GCC’s selective scheduling and pipelining algorithm over RTL regions. It computes available expressions across CFG boundaries, ranks and chooses the best movable expressions, performs code motion with substitution, renaming, bookkeeping, and speculation, manages fences and boundaries while forming scheduled groups, supports loop pipelining and later rescheduling of generated code, and coordinates global selective-scheduling initialization and per-region execution. This is the algorithmic core of selective scheduling, built on the IR and dump support in neighboring files.
same_name_distinction: This is the algorithmic core and top-level execution source for selective scheduling, driving region scheduling, fence processing, expression selection, code motion, and global setup/teardown. The same-stem header gcc/sel-sched.h is only the narrow external entry-point interface.
